styles.diner: Bright flat storybook illustration for a children's maths app, clean simple shapes, warm cheerful colours, soft even light, gentle texture, friendly and tidy, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos.

pictures.name: card
pictures.prompt: A cosy little retro take-away diner at night seen from the street, warm glowing windows, a red and white striped awning, a chunky brown paper take-away bag and a curly paper order ticket sitting on the front counter, a friendly round chef in a white hat waving from behind the counter, a calm deep-blue evening sky with a few stars at the top, wide landscape picture for a title card, the diner in the middle.

pictures.name: back-diner
pictures.prompt: Inside a bright friendly retro diner kitchen seen straight on from the customer side: a long clean pale counter across the bottom, a big plain pale-cream wall in the middle with a few simple shelves of jars and plates near the edges, a round wall clock, checkered tiles at the very top edge, the middle of the wall empty and calm so things placed on top stand out. Empty background scenery, no people, soft muted colours in the middle, wide landscape.

pictures.name: bag
pictures.prompt: One plain brown paper take-away bag standing upright, seen straight on from the front, a wide flat empty front face with no print, the top folded over twice, crisp gentle creases, slightly rounded corners. Single object, centred, the whole bag visible with space around it, on a plain pure white background, clean empty white all around.

pictures.name: ticket
pictures.prompt: One long blank paper order ticket from a diner, a tall narrow strip of off-white paper with a gently torn zigzag bottom edge and a small curl at the bottom, completely blank with no writing and no lines, seen straight on. Single object, centred, the whole ticket visible with space around it, on a plain pure white background, clean empty white all around.

pictures.name: chef
pictures.prompt: A friendly round cartoon diner chef, a cheerful kiwi bird with soft brown feathers, a long thin beak, a tall white chef's hat and a small white apron, smiling, one wing raised pointing upward as if explaining something, standing, full body, facing the viewer.
